slices.focus: Telehealth counseling helps manage accumulated strain
slices.summary: After months of early starts, family logistics, and after-hours training prep, Lucia realizes she's waking up braced for crisis every day and starts telehealth counseling. The practical, behavior-focused sessions target her habit of treating every schedule problem as a personal moral failure. She's learning to separate system flaws from self-blame and to recover faster after bad docket days. The conversation covers a proposed commute transition ritual (one song → write down urgent tasks → leave the rest) and Lucia's recognition that counseling is helping her arrive home less keyed up. She's tracking three markers: faster recovery after disruptions, evenings less contaminated by the day, and less late-night panic prep.
decisions: Telehealth counseling has helped Lucia separate court system flaws from personal blame and recover faster after bad dock
